messages.content: Hi, I'm Sam, a product designer at Pixelcraft. I'm allergic to peanuts.
Nice to meet you, Sam! I'll keep the peanut allergy in mind.
My partner Leah and I are planning a trip to Japan in December.
How exciting! December is a lovely time for Japan.
My new phone number is 98765 43210, please save it.
Please forget my phone number, I don't want it stored anywhere.
Done, I've forgotten your phone number.
Also, earlier I said I'm allergic to peanuts. That was wrong, I'm actually allergic to shellfish.
Thanks for correcting that: shellfish, not peanuts.
Change of plans: my partner and I moved the Japan trip to March.
Noted, the Japan trip is now in March.

distractor_sessions: My colleague Priyank is allergic to dairy, so we always order vegan at team lunches.
Leah's sister is visiting Korea in December.
Sounds like a fun trip for her.
The office helpdesk number is 1800 555 0199 if anyone asks.
